description: This file defines a controller class for handling transaction-related email notifications within the OpenCart admin interface. It retrieves customer transaction data and sends transactional emails to customers, utilizing the OpenCart email library and loading relevant language and store information.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling customer transaction email notifications in the admin area. It extends the core Controller class and provides an index method for processing and sending transaction emails based on customer ID, description, amount, and order ID.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that retrieves customer, store, and language data, prepares email content, and sends a transaction email to the specified customer.
